page.layout: One page: title block centred at top, engraving with motto in the middle, imprint at the foot. No margins.

main_text.l: Novo ad istius Canticum & hujus librum Propheticum Commentario illustrata, & cum justa rerum historia accuratius collata.

page.notes: Engraving between the subtitle and the imprint: a rural scene with a standing figure at left, a man with a plough and oxen at centre-right, and a hilly landscape behind. The banner beneath it carries the motto SPES ALIT AGRICOLAS, transcribed above. A small medallion above the engraving holds a tiny inscription that is too faint to read; marked as illegible. "Hisce" is printed "Hifce" and "istius", "illustrata" and "Hollandia" carry long s in the original, here rendered as plain s. The comma after "Hollandia" is as printed. Blue library stamp at right, omitted.
